presentation.chiefComplaint: Pressure in the chest on exertion for 3 weeks
presentation.history: Retrosternal pressure when climbing stairs or walking uphill, radiating to the left arm, settles within about 5 minutes of rest. No pain at rest. Patient is worried it is his heart. Smoker for 35 years, about 20 cigarettes a day. Known hypertension and type 2 diabetes on metformin and ramipril. Father had a heart attack at 58. No cough, no fever, no heartburn.
observations: BP 152/88, HR 78 regular, RR 14, SpO2 97%, BMI 31
Chest wall not tender, pain not reproducible by palpation
Heart sounds normal, no murmur, lungs clear, no leg oedema
Resting ECG in the practice: sinus rhythm, no ST changes
